nc1_temporal_index.conclusion: Temporal positional metadata alone has near-zero discriminative capacity, confirming the model relies on semantic visual transitions.

nc2_repeated_frame.conclusion: When temporal variation is eliminated, the GRU's advantage evaporates, proving it requires true frame-to-frame dynamics.

nc3_static_scene.conclusion: On low-dynamics scenes, temporal ordering provides minimal gain, verifying that the temporal head acts selectively on dynamic events.

nc4_luminance_norm.conclusion: Luminance and feature magnitude normalization do not degrade the chronological temporal advantage.
